children.text: Introduction

More AI assistants now promise to work for you in the background, and some can even talk on the phone. But they do very different things. This page compares one thing in detail: giving work to an AI by calling it on WhatsApp, and getting the finished result back on WhatsApp.

We compare Classgrid AI with three new products from big AI companies: OpenAI Dots, Grok Bot from xAI, and Meta Muse. Everything here is based on public information as of October 2026. These products change quickly, so check their own pages too.
How a WhatsApp call to Classgrid AI works
Classgrid AI is an AI agent at chat.classgrid.in. Once you verify your WhatsApp number, you can call the Classgrid number, +91 81492 77038, on WhatsApp and simply say what you need.
The AI picks up and greets you by name. You talk normally and can interrupt it at any time.
It can answer you live during the call, using the apps you connected, like Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Notion or GitHub.
For bigger jobs, it notes what you asked and starts working as soon as you hang up.
When the work is done, you get the result on WhatsApp with a link to the full chat. Files like PDFs arrive as real files.
You can add more by sending a WhatsApp message or emailing agent@classgrid.in while the job is still running. A job can keep going for up to 48 hours.
Each call can last up to 15 minutes and the AI speaks English. It is a WhatsApp voice call, so a normal phone call to the number will not reach the AI.
OpenAI Dots
OpenAI launched Dots at its DevDay event on 29 September 2026. Dots are always-on agents that work in the background, each with its own cloud computer, and they connect to thousands of apps (
TechCrunch
The Next Web

You reach Dots inside ChatGPT, Slack and Microsoft Teams, on OpenAI's paid plans. Reports say Dots does not work on WhatsApp and cannot be called. OpenAI's separate 1-800-ChatGPT phone line works in the US and Canada only, and ChatGPT on WhatsApp is now only available in Europe (
The Decoder
When Dots is a good fit
Dots suits people who already work all day in ChatGPT, Slack or Teams and want agents running in the background there.
Grok Bot (xAI)
Grok Bot is xAI's agent. It reportedly runs on a cloud computer, works from apps on Mac, Windows and iPhone, connects to email and calendar apps, and can run on a schedule.
Since 25 October 2026, Grok Bot can make phone calls for you to businesses or people and send you a summary (
Tesla North
). That means Grok calls other people. You cannot call Grok Bot yourself, and there is reportedly no official Grok WhatsApp number.
When Grok Bot is a good fit
Grok Bot suits people who want an agent to phone businesses on their behalf, and who are happy to give it tasks from its own apps.
Meta Muse

Meta's Muse is a personal agent app launched on 8 September 2026. It can send emails, fill in forms and keep working after you close the app. At launch it is available in the US only and not in India (
MediaNama
Muse started placing calls to US businesses in September 2026 (
TechCrunch
), and Meta rolled that feature back after reports about how the calls were made. Meta AI's voice chat inside WhatsApp is a voice session in the app, not a phone call you make to an agent.
When Muse is a good fit
Muse suits people in the US who already use Meta's apps and want an agent that can act for them there.

children.text: When to choose Classgrid AI
Choose Classgrid AI when you want to hand off work by voice, from anywhere in India, without opening an app, and get the finished work back on WhatsApp.
You are driving, travelling or away from your laptop and want to say what you need in a quick call.
You want the agent to keep working after the call and send you the result, not just answer a question.
You want PDFs and other files delivered straight to WhatsApp.
You want the same agent on the web too, with research, files, code, Project Mode and Grids.
Good to know
Calls are WhatsApp voice calls in English, up to 15 minutes each.
You need to sign up at chat.classgrid.in and verify your WhatsApp number first.
Sending a WhatsApp text on its own does not start a new job. You start a job by calling or by emailing agent@classgrid.in.
Classgrid AI is free to start, and you top up only when you need more.
